column1: # Author: Lane #1644 (Codex). Individual read-based dispositions; repository LF source and final #1693 composition.

column8: Historical binding treats failed constituent admission as an unavailable guard; it never claims a data result and preserves the structural boundary.

Shutdown-marker aggregation admits each readable constituent through getConstituent and returns its admission error before consulting exact StartupMaintenanceStateEngine. It never treats a failed admission as a clean-shutdown boolean.
Prefix edge count already returns getConstituent and per-child count/fallback errors with the partial count. No native or forwarded counter implementation is added.
Edge-head source probing skipped admission and could fabricate ErrNotFound; it now returns the cause, while genuine child ErrNotFound can select the next source.
Latest effective edge probing now distinguishes failed admission from a child absence and retains the child effective-time read owner.
Latest visible edge probing now carries the source admission cause before attempting its existing visibility capability.
Historical edge lookup previously replaced an admission failure with absence; it returns the admission cause and retains version-bound reads.
Historical endpoint-pair read now preserves both qualified private-selector errors and unqualified child admission errors before merging edges.
Historical type aggregation cannot claim an empty/partial type set when one selected constituent fails admission; existing error return carries that cause.
Historical incoming adjacency now returns required-source admission failure rather than skipping a source and accepting partial edges.
Node-head source probing now preserves admission failures; only actual entity absence remains eligible for a later source.
Latest effective node probing now returns admission failure before invoking the existing effective-time capability.
Latest visible node probing now preserves admission failure instead of manufacturing node absence.
Projected point lookup keeps its selected property owner and now returns a source admission error rather than falling through to another source.
Version-bound node lookup retains the requested version and now preserves admission errors separately from genuine not-found.
Historical label aggregation now refuses a failed required source through its existing error channel rather than returning an incomplete collection.
Historical outgoing adjacency now returns source admission failure rather than a successful partial relationship collection.
Failed source admission is skipped before namespace selection, so a known namespace schema can become nil. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.
Mutation-version metadata is a cache-validity token with an explicit supported bool. Failed admission now returns unsupported, preventing a partial token being accepted as complete identity.

Skips an inaccessible lifecycle-status provider, returning an empty/partial diagnostic map with no admission cause. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.
Skips failed source admission and returns an empty/partial namespace list with no error channel. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.

Clean-shutdown publication returns getConstituent failure before invoking the exact maintenance owner; a missing optional maintenance interface may be skipped, but a failed required source cannot be reported as successful publication.
Namespace/label count already returns admission and namespaceLabelCount errors. Release namespacedPrefixCount remains the native qualification owner; no forwarding is added.
Prefix node count already returns admission and selected native/fallback count errors; its existing per-child scalar contract is retained.
PauseLifecycle is a void control broadcast to reachable exact lifecycle providers, not a read outcome. It retains OwnedCapability and the release best-effort notification contract.

Skips a failed constituent and reports a smaller pending-work count; the int-only protocol has no error-returning peer. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.

MVCC pruning returns the admission error alongside the accumulated count, then invokes the constituent's exact maintenance capability. Unsupported optional pruning and failed source admission are distinct outcomes.

Temporal pruning preserves the accumulated count with a source-admission or prune error. It selects exact TemporalMaintenanceEngine after admission and never converts a required constituent failure to zero success.

MVCC-head rebuild returns source admission failure before invoking exact MVCCMaintenanceEngine. The retained per-source rebuild owner supplies preparation behavior; the composite only sequences admitted members.

Temporal-index rebuild returns failed source admission before calling exact TemporalMaintenanceEngine, and propagates that owner's error. It contains no duplicate rebuild or read-view preparation protocol.

Snapshot-reader registration returns cleanup for the lifecycle providers actually registered; it is lifetime metadata, not capture or entity materialization. Captured data reads have a separate mandatory admission/error owner.
ResumeLifecycle is a void exact-owner control broadcast, retaining its existing best-effort notification contract rather than claiming a successful data result.
Schedule installation has an error terminal and now reports admission failure before invoking the exact lifecycle schedule owner.

Public node streaming returns required constituent admission failure, then streams through the issued Engine while assigning source identity. Its existing stopped/callback error path remains the terminal; it never substitutes a native adapter for reads.

Explicit prune triggering admits each readable member and returns any admission or exact lifecycle invocation error. An unsupported optional lifecycle is skipped by capability policy, whereas an inaccessible member cannot acknowledge success.
Embedding sidecar update first resolves the entity through admitted reads. Admission failure now returns its cause; only actual not-found selects another source, and the updater remains exact.
The bound label-count aggregate already returns admission and CountNodesWithLabel failures; its scalar implementation and counter ownership are unchanged.
eventTargets selects exact event recipients and groups their namespace projections. It returns a subscription target list, not graph data or a read-success terminal.
AllEdges could silently skip an inaccessible source; it now returns admission failure before reading or source-tagging that child collection.

AllNodes admits each selected source and returns nil plus the error on failure. Successful child collections preserve their constituent identity; this required collection does not skip failed members.
Bulk edge creation uses point reads to choose its source. Admission failure now stops routing instead of selecting a later/default writer after an unread source.

The writable-source edge fallback admits the candidate view, verifies both endpoints with its visible GetNode and acquires that same alias's write owner. Only genuine endpoint absence permits another candidate; hard read/admission failure terminates before effects.

The final read-only-source diagnostic admits each previously untried source before its visible start-node lookup. Admission/read failure is propagated; finding the start there reports read-only refusal instead of selecting a different physical writer.
EdgeCount now returns required-source admission failure rather than successful undercount; native/forwarded counter bodies remain owned by release/TJ.
Type-specific edge count now returns required-source admission failure instead of an incomplete successful sum; existing child counter dispatch is unchanged.
Exported constituent lookup directly returns getConstituent engine/error, preserving the live admission decision without a second resolver.
Exported errorless edge lookup retains nil/omission behavior and source ordering. It must be Deprecated and inaccessible to internal consumers; errors are available from GetEdgesBetween.
Endpoint-pair read now propagates qualified selector and unqualified admission errors through its existing collection/error API, without a second source selector.
Type collection now returns a selected-source admission failure rather than successful partial edges; source tagging remains unchanged.

The first-label lookup returns admission failure before searching the issued child. It returns the first source-tagged node; only actual not-found or nil-node permits another source, while any hard child error reaches the caller.
Errorless in-degree retains zero/omitted failed constituent behavior. Internal callers must use GetIncomingEdges and handle its error; no signature break or new counter forwarding.
Incoming adjacency now reports admission failure rather than returning a partial successful list, retaining same-source endpoint selection.

Label collection returns failed source admission or child label-read error instead of a partial successful list. Successful nodes are copied through sourceNode so the original provider's data and database identity are retained.
Errorless out-degree retains zero/omitted failed constituent behavior. Internal callers must use GetOutgoingEdges and preserve errors; public signature stays compatible.
Outgoing adjacency now reports source admission failure rather than successful partial edges, retaining source identity.

Merges stored constraint/index managers; failed source admission is skipped and returns an empty/partial SchemaManager. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.
NodeCount now reports required-source admission failure instead of successful undercount; no native count implementation or forwarding is changed.
Edge update source probing now returns admission failure before point lookup and exact writer selection.

UpdateNode resolves candidate scope, admits the candidate and uses its visible point lookup. The successful alias then supplies getConstituentForWrite; a read/admission error cannot be interpreted as absence and retarget an unrelated writer.
Write admission checks the immutable access mode then directly carries read admission error before requesting write admission from the same participant owner.
Positional scalar aggregation now returns failed admission through its existing int64/error channel; count callback implementations and forwarded counters remain unchanged.
ConstituentStorage selects the qualified database with the common catalog and directly returns getConstituent error; it does not materialize a body or invent another owner.
Private qualified selector previously discarded getConstituent error. It now returns the cause so data APIs can propagate it while legacy producers preserve omission compatibility.

The shared source resolver obtains each requested child through c.getConstituent after immutable catalog/live-alias selection. Admission failures return before the child read and before deletion can obtain write authority; there is no bare constituent-map execution path or whole-container fallback.

The reservation stream branch returns getConstituent failure before starting that child. Existing deferred release closes previously acquired reservations; refused/errored preparation cannot turn earlier reserved rows into a successful partial stream.

The fallback-capable branch admits each child before VisitWithCapability binds its read operation and child fallback. Admission failure returns directly, and only that child's issued provider may execute its fallback; no whole-container replay occurs.
Projected edge matching now returns source admission failure before provider/fallback matching, retaining its existing predicate and deduplication policy.

Skips a failed constituent before applying the ID predicate, so the integer result can omit that source without an error channel. Counterpart-less, tracked NOR-287 under Nornic2’s 27 Oct class ruling; no new API in #1644.
Historical availability metadata treats failed admission as unavailable and returns false. Actual reads carry their own error; no successful data result is produced here.
Stored read admission constructs only required child requests, returns any participant/provider refusal before results, then uses the common stored operation and source transform owner.
